schemaObjects.name: AiGenerationBatch
schemaObjects.sql: CREATE TABLE AiGenerationBatch (BatchId TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, BookId INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES Book(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE, BookUid TEXT NOT NULL, DocumentKeyJson TEXT NOT NULL, ScopeSha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(ScopeSha256)=64), CreatedUtcTicks INTEGER NOT NULL, Status INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(Status IN(0,1)), InsertedCount INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(InsertedCount>=0), DuplicateCount INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(DuplicateCount>=0), RejectedCount INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(RejectedCount>=0), InsertedQuoteIdsJson TEXT NOT NULL)

schemaObjects.name: AiGenerationBatchItem
schemaObjects.sql: CREATE TABLE AiGenerationBatchItem (BatchId TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES AiGenerationBatch(BatchId) ON DELETE CASCADE, QuoteId INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES Quote(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CreatedRevision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(CreatedRevision>=0), CreatedContentHash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CreatedContentHash)=64), PRIMARY KEY(BatchId,QuoteId))

schemaObjects.name: AppMetadata
schemaObjects.sql: CREATE TABLE AppMetadata (Key TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, Value TEXT NOT NULL)

schemaObjects.name: Book
schemaObjects.sql:
CREATE TABLE "Book" (
"Id" integer primary key autoincrement not null ,
"Title" varchar ,
"Author" varchar ,
"Category" varchar ,
"TotalPages" integer ,
"Description" varchar ,
"CreatedAt" bigint ,
"UpdatedAt" bigint , Kind INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(Kind IN (0,1)), BookUid TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')

schemaObjects.name: EbookFile
schemaObjects.sql: CREATE TABLE EbookFile (BookId INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES Book(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE, FileId TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, Format INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(Format IN (1,2)), SourceRelativePath TEXT NOT NULL, CanonicalRelativePath TEXT NOT NULL, SourceSha256 TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(SourceSha256)=64), CanonicalSha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CanonicalSha256)=64), SourceBytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(SourceBytes>=0), ParserVersion INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ParserVersion>0), ImportedUtcTicks INTEGER NOT NULL, Status INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(Status IN(0,1,2)))

schemaObjects.name: EbookProgress
schemaObjects.sql: CREATE TABLE EbookProgress (BookId INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES Book(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE, DocumentKeyJson TEXT NOT NULL, LastPositionJson TEXT NOT NULL, HasStarted INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(HasStarted IN(0,1)), CurrentPercent REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(CurrentPercent>=0 AND CurrentPercent<=100), CompletedUtcTicks INTEGER NULL, CompletedOffsetMinutes INTEGER NULL, LastOpenedUtcTicks INTEGER NOT NULL, LastSavedUtcTicks INTEGER NOT NULL, CHECK(CompletedUtcTicks IS NULL OR HasStarted=1), CHECK((CompletedUtcTicks IS NULL)=(CompletedOffsetMinutes IS NULL)), CHECK((CompletedUtcTicks IS NULL AND CompletedOffsetMinutes IS NULL) OR (CompletedUtcTicks IS NOT NULL AND CompletedOffsetMinutes BETWEEN -840 AND 840)))

schemaObjects.name: EbookReadingSession
schemaObjects.sql: CREATE TABLE EbookReadingSession (SessionId TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, BookId INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES Book(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE, BookUid TEXT NOT NULL, DocumentKeyJson TEXT NOT NULL, StartPositionJson TEXT NOT NULL, EndPositionJson TEXT NOT NULL, StartPercent REAL NOT NULL CHECK(StartPercent>=0 AND StartPercent<=100), EndPercent REAL NOT NULL CHECK(EndPercent>=0 AND EndPercent<=100), OpenedUtcTicks INTEGER NOT NULL, ClosedUtcTicks INTEGER NOT NULL, OpenedOffsetMinutes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(OpenedOffsetMinutes BETWEEN -840 AND 840), ClosedOffsetMinutes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ClosedOffsetMinutes BETWEEN -840 AND 840), DurationMilliseconds INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(DurationMilliseconds>=0), CloseLocalDate TEXT NOT NULL, ClockAnomaly INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ClockAnomaly IN(0,1)))

schemaObjects.name: Quote
schemaObjects.sql: CREATE TABLE Quote (Id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, BookId INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES Book(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE, Text TEXT NOT NULL, Thoughts TEXT, Page INTEGER, IsFavorite INTEGER NOT NULL, CreatedAt BIGINT NOT NULL, UpdatedAt BIGINT NOT NULL, Revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(Revision>=0))

schemaObjects.name: QuoteOrigin
schemaObjects.sql: CREATE TABLE QuoteOrigin (QuoteId INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES Quote(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE, Source INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(Source IN(0,1,2)), OriginalText TEXT NOT NULL, DocumentKeyJson TEXT NULL, StartPositionJson TEXT NULL, EndPositionJson TEXT NULL, PrefixHash TEXT NULL, SuffixHash TEXT NULL, LocationStatus INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(LocationStatus IN(0,1,2)), BatchId TEXT NULL REFERENCES AiGenerationBatch(BatchId) ON DELETE SET NULL, DedupeKey TEXT NULL UNIQUE, CHECK((DocumentKeyJson IS NULL AND StartPositionJson IS NULL AND EndPositionJson IS NULL AND DedupeKey IS NULL) OR (DocumentKeyJson IS NOT NULL AND StartPositionJson IS NOT NULL AND EndPositionJson IS NOT NULL AND DedupeKey IS NOT NULL)))

schemaObjects.name: ReadingPlan
schemaObjects.sql: CREATE TABLE ReadingPlan (Id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, BookId INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES Book(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE, StartDate BIGINT NOT NULL, TargetDate BIGINT NOT NULL)

schemaObjects.name: ReadingRecord
schemaObjects.sql: CREATE TABLE ReadingRecord (Id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, BookId INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES Book(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE, ReadingDate BIGINT NOT NULL, StartPage INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(StartPage>=1), EndPage INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(EndPage>=StartPage), Minutes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(Minutes>0))

schemaObjects.name: TR_AiBatch_Receipt_Immutable
schemaObjects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER TR_AiBatch_Receipt_Immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON AiGenerationBatch WHEN NEW.BatchId<>OLD.BatchId OR NEW.BookId<>OLD.BookId OR NEW.BookUid<>OLD.BookUid OR NEW.DocumentKeyJson<>OLD.DocumentKeyJson OR NEW.ScopeSha256<>OLD.ScopeSha256 OR NEW.CreatedUtcTicks<>OLD.CreatedUtcTicks OR NEW.InsertedQuoteIdsJson<>OLD.InsertedQuoteIdsJson OR NEW.InsertedCount<>OLD.InsertedCount OR NEW.DuplicateCount<>OLD.DuplicateCount OR NEW.RejectedCount<>OLD.RejectedCount BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable batch receipt'); END

schemaObjects.name: TR_AiGenerationBatch_INSERT_Identity
schemaObjects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER TR_AiGenerationBatch_INSERT_Identity BEFORE INSERT ON AiGenerationBatch WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Book WHERE Id=NEW.BookId AND BookUid=NEW.BookUid) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'book identity mismatch'); END
